title: Bachelor of Science in Business Administration
tagline: Learn to lead organizations, build ventures, and make decisions grounded in evidence.
overview:
The Bachelor of Science in Business Administration prepares you to understand, manage, and lead organizations of every size. You start with a broad introduction to business and the economic way of thinking, then master the essential tools of the field: accounting, finance, marketing, management, law, and analytics.

In your upper-division years you deepen your expertise in operations, information systems, human resources, international business, entrepreneurship, and leadership, and you choose electives in areas such as digital marketing, investments, and artificial intelligence in business. Your program concludes with Strategic Management and a capstone project in which you bring the entire curriculum to bear on a real business challenge.
outcomes: Analyze financial statements and use financial tools to evaluate business decisions.
Develop marketing, operational, and strategic plans grounded in data and market research.
Lead and collaborate effectively in diverse teams and organizations.
Apply ethical reasoning and legal principles to business situations.
Use analytics and information systems to improve organizational performance.
Communicate business ideas persuasively to professional audiences.
